newsitem.title: USA: Halliburton, NUMAR waiting period ends.
newsitem.headline: Halliburton, NUMAR waiting period ends.

text.p: Halliburton Co and NUMAR Corp said on Monday the waiting period for Hart-Scott- Rodino anti-trust review of Halliburton's planned acquisition of NUMAR Corporation lapsed as of July 13, 1997.

Both companies said in a joint statement that they expect the acquisition to close in the 1997 third quarter, following completion of Securities and Exchange Commission review of NUMAR's proxy statement for a special shareholders meeting and a shareholder vote approving the deal.
The date of such shareholders meeting has not been set, but will take place as soon as practicable.
Halliburton said on June 10 that it had reached an agreement to acquire NUMAR for $360 million, or $39.62 per NUMAR share, in a stock swap.
